name: PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk
summary: PT Grahaprima Suksesmandiri Tbk is an Indonesian enterprise primarily engaged in the transportation and logistics sector. The company delivers a variety of trucking solutions, which include vehicle leasing, on-demand transport, dedicated fleet operations, and both fixed and adaptable service contracts. Established in 2004, its principal office is located in Central Jakarta, Indonesia.
